<thought>Applying the amide‑formation retrosynthetic template breaks the C–N bond of the amide, giving the corresponding carboxylic acid and the amine that supplied the nitrogen. The rest of the molecule (the tolyl‑sulfonyl‑phenyl framework) stays unchanged. Therefore the two precursors are: the same scaffold with a carboxylic acid instead of the amide, and an aniline that provides the nitrogen.</thought>
<final_answer>[["Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1","Nc1ccccc1"]]</final_answer>
